news.title: Consumer sentiment hits record low, inflation fears rise amid Iran war
news.description: The university's headline index of consumer sentiment tumbled to 47.6, down 10.7% from March to its lowest on record.

news.title: Trump praises Palantir with stock down 15% this week as Iran conflict drags on
news.description: Palantir's Maven platform have reportedly been used in the U.S. military campaign in Iran.

news.title: Michael Burry says he's still betting against Palantir after Trump post boosts stock
news.description: The investor of the "Big Short" fame said he continues to hold long-dated put options on the artificial intelligence software firm.
